source: Pikorua SignalK history API, resolution=60s, captured 2026-11-10
units: SignalK SI: revolutions Hz, temperatures K, pressures Pa, engineLoad ratio, fuel.rate m3/s, speedOverGround m/s
notes: fuel.rate is the ECU injection command, not measured flow. transmission.oilTemperature may be a CANvu placeholder; check before use. SLICE: only the minutes in which an engine reported are kept (the rest carry only navigation.speedOverGround), and values are rounded to 7 significant digits.
